issue_summary.SOURCE_CHECK: While these cell lines are mentioned in the paper, only the material used for the mass spectrometry (MS) analysis is valid; the MS section describes analyzing "pulldown samples" to identify E3 ubiquitin ligases interacting with TGF-β1 and PKA, and phosphorylation of TGF-β1.
